properties.description: `reflow2 hook vscode` (loop_nudge.py --harness vscode): SessionStart runs loop_status through the door and returns its `next` list as additionalContext; Stop reads the session's calls from reflow2's usage ledger, counts each through the same count_call the Claude hook uses, exports the committed record when the turn wrote and no MCP config keeps it current (never over a non-export), and nudges once in VS Code's shape. No hook reads command text. loop_status reads a .github/hooks file running `reflow2 hook vscode` as an installed nudge, and no longer says none is possible for VS Code. Answers limitation 9.
properties.name: The loop nudge reaches a --call agent in VS Code through hooks the terminal route installs, counting door writes from the usage ledger
